abilities.name: Ember Vigil
abilities.text: Once per round, at the start of your turn in danger 3+ or while scenario pressure is above 0, take 1 Wound. If pressure is above 0, reduce it by 1.

abilities.name: Ash Psalm
abilities.text: Once per round, after resolving Emberwatch Brace or Ember Sanctum Rest, record 1 Vow Note.

abilities.name: Bone Bell
abilities.text: Once per round, when scenario pressure first rises on your turn, record 1 Vow Note and reduce that increase by 1.

abilities.name: Cinder Oath
abilities.text: At the Cinder Gate during your action phase, spend 1 Vow Note before a scenario confrontation to add +2 to each confrontation test. Weakness: Vow Notes cannot be used for shop, salvage, or Contract rewards.
